verses.english: “There are, mendicants, these two kinds of happiness.
The happiness of attachments, and the happiness of no attachments.
These are the two kinds of happiness.

verses.pali: Etadaggaṁ, bhikkhave, imesaṁ dvinnaṁ sukhānaṁ yadidaṁ nirupadhisukhan”ti.
verses.english: The better of these two kinds of happiness is the happiness of no attachments.”
